name: portsume
description: Portsume — turn any resume into a stunning portfolio website.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w client
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
